message: I remember the last blackout we had—it felt like the universe was playing a little joke on me. I had always been the one scrambling for a flashlight or borrowing a phone charger. But this time, I was ready! I pulled out my trusty power bank, set up my lantern, and even managed to whip up a little dinner with a portable stove. It felt great to finally be the prepared one for once! Have you had a moment like that? What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a power outage? 😊
